execution_receipt.launcher: MPI4; rank 0 emitted the fatal and MPI_Abort

failure.temperature_table_retry: The prior 00:40 LW frozen-temperature range failure was passed by this extended-temperature table run; this later failure is distinct.

source_trace.fact: The wrapper copies interface pressure as Pw1D(k)=p8w(i,k,j)/100, sets plev(1)=pw1d(1), plev(k+1)=pw1d(k+1), and computes pdel(k)=plev(k)-plev(k+1). The layer ordering comment says bottom to top.
The UDM builder validates this pressure-thickness vector before the radiation column is queued/flushed into rrtmgp_lw_column.

The first pressure validation is rrtmgp_check_positive('dp_hpa',RESHAPE(dp_hpa,[n,1])). That calls check_finite and emits DP_HPA_NOT_FINITE on a nonfinite value. This failure occurs before frozen-optics lookup or RTE evaluation for that call.

Host UDM dry layer mass is built separately from pressure as -DNW*(C1H*MUT+C2H)/g. Radiation still receives p8w and passes it to the wrapper. Thus the UDM dry-mass denominator is not the source of the named DP_HPA validation failure.

source_trace.path_and_lines: module_ra_rrtmgp.F:361-405 (SW) and frozen LW add path in same adapter
source_trace.fact: Frozen optics are added inside the RRTMGP adapter after a column call begins. They cannot directly alter p8w or this call's pdel before the builder check; a previous radiation heating feedback could only be an indirect trajectory influence.

established: At 00:50 the UDM LW builder received a nonfinite dp_hpa element at the first element of the vector it checked.
dp_hpa is formed from adjacent WRF interface pressures p8w divided by 100 and differenced.
not_established: The exact rank-local/global i,j or WRF k index, p8w values on both interfaces, whether either p8w operand was already nonfinite, and which preceding timestep first produced the bad state are absent from the fatal record.
No source evidence establishes whether the pressure state became nonfinite from unrelated WRF dynamics, from an indirect prior radiation-heating feedback, or another model-state issue.

The accepted RA4 run uses the same initial and boundary files (wrfinput SHA 6adeb00d56b83ef7749502059e35d27adb5114ac0e03adb323e86aa68b946fe3; wrfbdy SHA 2298ac9b6dfec71e434648f66160f6555f89ec351398a4abf76754d1f934d29b) and completes, but its different radiation trajectory means this does not isolate the cause or prove that the RA37 pressure at 00:50 should match.
interpretation.diagnostic_message_limitation: The generic helper reshapes the 1-D layer vector to (n,1), but its checker prints the first index as 'column' and the singleton second index as 'layer'. Therefore 'column=1 layer=1' does not identify a global WRF column; it is a misleading generic array-index label. The caller's global i,j context is bypassed by this generic check.
